source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What does a model's context window describe?

options.text: The size of the matrices learned during model training.
options.feedback: Matrix sizes help determine parameter count. The context window instead concerns the sequence available during a run.

options.text: The speed at which the model selects output tokens.
options.feedback: Generation speed measures throughput. Context capacity measures how much sequence material can be considered.

options.text: The maximum sequence material the model can consider per run.
options.feedback: Context includes supplied and generated material within the system's capacity. It is distinct from parameter count.

options.text: The count of times a recurrent block is reused per token.
options.feedback: Recurrent passes describe computation on representations. They do not define the capacity of the context window.
